name: ocr-pdf-studio-promo
description: Remotion promotional videos for OCR PDF Studio (9:16 and 16:9).

scripts.render:vertical: remotion render OcrPdfStudio-Vertical out/OCR-PDF-Studio-Launch-9x16.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.render:landscape: remotion render OcrPdfStudio-Landscape out/OCR-PDF-Studio-Launch-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:landscape
